name: managing-tax-controversy
description: Manages federal tax controversies from IRS examination through Appeals, Tax Court and refund litigation, as drafts for professional review. Builds a clocks register, each deadline from its own trigger with the IRC 7503 roll: assessment statute (IRC 6501, Form 872 and 872-A), refund claims and look-back (IRC 6511), the 90- or 150-day deficiency petition (IRC 6213(a)) and its circuit-by-circuit jurisdictional and tolling status after Boechler and Culp, BBA modification and push-out windows, and collection due process (IRC 6320, 6330). Covers IDR responses, protests, Appeals ex parte rules (Rev. Proc. 2012-18), penalty defense (IRC 6662, 6664(c), 6751(b) supervisory approval, first-time abatement), privilege (IRC 7525, Kovel, work product), and competent authority (MAP) and APA requests on transfer pricing adjustments (Rev. Procs. 2015-40, 2015-41). Use for IRS audit, protest, notice of deficiency, Tax Court petition, statute extension, refund claim, penalty abatement, BBA audit, CDP hearing, MAP or APA.
